summary: Knox Frank, 34, backcountry skier from Crested Butte, killed in a massive wet-slab avalanche near Ophir Pass while skiing with three friends; the slide broke above him about 3:30 p.m. Friday, ran ~5,000 ft, and carried him ~1,000 ft downhill. Wearing a beacon, he was found 30-45 minutes later buried under seven feet of snow; CPR was unsuccessful and he was pronounced dead at the scene. The Opus hut owner called for help when the party was overdue; a Helitrax helicopter assisted in the search.
location: Near Ophir Pass, Opus backcountry hut area
responding_agency: Helitrax; San Miguel County Sheriff's Office
